description: This file defines interface functions and types for handling timers in the RdkEasyMeshController component. It includes function prototypes for initializing, registering, unregistering, restarting, changing, and querying timers, as well as type definitions for timer identifiers and callback functions.

methods.name: map_timer_register_callback
methods.description: Registers a new timer callback with specified frequency, ID, arguments, and callback function.

methods.name: map_is_timer_registered
methods.description: Checks if a timer ID is already registered.

methods.name: map_timer_unregister_callback
methods.description: Unregisters a specific timer callback using its ID.

methods.name: map_timer_unregister_callback_prefix
methods.description: Unregisters all timer callbacks whose IDs start with a given prefix.

methods.name: map_timer_handler_fini
methods.description: Cleans up all timer resources, should be called upon exit.

methods.name: map_timer_restart_callback
methods.description: Restarts a timer identified by its ID.

methods.name: map_timer_change_callback
methods.description: Changes the frequency and arguments of an existing timer.

methods.name: map_timer_remaining
methods.description: Retrieves the remaining time before a timer expires.
